items.title: Tablet top da Samsung vaza com tela gigante e bateria de 11.600 mAh
items.pt:
O Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra, próximo tablet top de linha da Samsung, teve especificações completas reveladas pouco antes do anúncio oficial. O modelo deve trazer tela de 14,6 polegadas, bateria de 11.600 mAh e corpo de apenas 5,1 mm de espessura.
As informações apareceram em uma listagem antecipada de uma loja online do Azerbaijão. O aparelho citado é a versão com 5G, 12 GB de RAM e 256 GB de armazenamento, na cor cinza. Os dados também vão de encontro com informações que já tinham aparecido em vazam

items.title: LabTrack API
items.pt:
My journey starts pretty far from tech. After years in scientific research (Biotechnology at UFU, Master's at UNIFESP), I'm transitioning into back-end development and data.

I built the LabTrack API to organize lab experiments, samples, and reagents, a problem I got to know up close during my time in scientific research.

Python, FastAPI, and SQLAlchemy, with the API already live and documented via Swagger.

What I noticed building this project is that the researcher's instinct to distrust data

items.title: LLM Agents Can Easily Tamper With Their Own Traces
items.pt: Asynchronous monitoring, incident investigations, and compliance audits primarily rely on agent traces to reconstruct what happened. We show that local LLM agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Open Code and Grok Build fail to enforce this boundary. items.title: Agentic Detection of Online Conspiracies
items.pt: Conspiratorial discourse on social media is not always expressed through explicit claims or stable lexical markers. The same surface content may express endorsement, legitimate concerns, criticism, satire, or mockery. items.title: RAPID: Robot Agentic Programming from Demonstrations
items.pt: Coding agents have demonstrated enormous success in solving complex programming problems. To leverage their potential for robot systems, this work introduces Robot Agentic Programming from Demonstrations (RAPID), which automatically generates, verifies, and refines robot programs, given a single visual human demonstration.
